objective: Determine whether accepted Project FAR artifacts require split authority relations and artifact-contract dependency classifications before experiment preregistration.

undifferentiated_owner.description: One owner field represents definition, classification, formalization, methodology, operations, protocol, and governance authority.
undifferentiated_owner.falsifier: Any accepted term or artifact requiring two distinct authority roles or any missing required authority role.

split_authority.description: Canonical definition, candidate classification, formalization, methodology, operations, protocol, and governance are separate authority relations.
split_authority.falsifier: Accepted sources assign the same role to conflicting locations or fail to support one of the proposed distinctions.

logical_derivation.description: FAR methodology and FARO operations are logical consequences of FARA or its formal kernel.
logical_derivation.falsifier: Accepted boundary/derivation authority rejects the theorem claim and no accepted proof establishes it.

artifact_workflow_contract.description: FAR and FARO consume and preserve upstream representation or investigation artifacts without being logically entailed by them.
artifact_workflow_contract.falsifier: Accepted sources explicitly establish necessary derivation or do not record any upstream artifact/workflow dependency.

unclassified_dependency.description: The accepted repository does not determine the dependency kind.
unclassified_dependency.falsifier: Accepted sources explicitly determine the dependency as derivational or contractual.

checks.name: canonical_definition_authority
checks.criterion: The shared-theory definitions artifact declares repository-wide canonical definition authority and contains headings for all seven candidate primitives.

checks.name: fara_candidate_classification
checks.criterion: The FARA primitive registry lists exactly the seven candidate primitives and points canonical definitions to shared theory.

checks.name: undifferentiated_registry_adequacy
checks.criterion: The current semantic owner registry explicitly represents all seven candidate primitives and can preserve both definition and FARA classification authority.

checks.name: formal_kernel_role_boundary
checks.criterion: The accepted formal kernel is a scoped FARA formalization and explicitly does not reclassify the seven candidate primitives or establish global primitive properties.

checks.name: far_dependency_kind
checks.criterion: Accepted FAR and boundary records determine whether FARA supplies an artifact contract or logically derives FAR procedure.

checks.name: faro_dependency_kind
checks.criterion: Accepted FARO and boundary records determine whether FARA/FAR supply artifact/workflow contracts or logically derive FARO operations.

checks.name: protocol_derivation_boundary
checks.criterion: Accepted derivation authority classifies canonicalization, CIR, evaluator rules, Pareto comparison, preregistration, and fail reporting as methodology/governance rather than theory consequences.

decision_rule.undifferentiated_owner: Pass only if C1-C3 show one owner relation completely preserves every accepted authority commitment.
decision_rule.split_authority: Pass only if C1-C4 support distinct definition, classification, and formalization roles without contradiction.
decision_rule.logical_derivation: Pass only if C5-C7 identify accepted derivations or proofs for downstream procedures.
decision_rule.artifact_workflow_contract: Pass only if C5-C7 explicitly support consumption/preservation dependencies while rejecting necessary procedural derivation.
decision_rule.unclassified_dependency: Pass only if C5-C7 do not determine either derivation or contract status.
